items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Clothing-only edit of a desktop-pet sprite sheet.
IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET: DeepSeek original maid walking sheet, 1024 x 1536, 3 columns and 4 rows, exactly 12 full-body walking poses. IMAGE 2 is CLOTHING DESIGN ONLY; do NOT copy its head size, body, leg length, pose or hair.
Replace only the maid dress, apron, long sleeves and boots in image 1 with the short-sleeved school sports uniform from image 2: white zip-front sports shirt with navy shoulder and upper-arm sleeve panels, cyan piping, small blue whale chest emblem, navy athletic shorts ending well above the knees with white side stripes, white low-top sneakers with cyan/navy accents and short white ankle socks. No long sleeves and no trousers.
Lock every original pose and all original pixel coordinates from image 1: same head/face size and expression, head-to-body ratio, blue hair silhouette, ahoge, fin ears, cyan bow, identity maid headband, tail, shoulder/hip widths, torso, elbows, wrists, knees, ankles and sole positions. The purpose is trying clothes on the original character, never redrawing a shorter or rounder person. Do not enlarge the head, shorten legs, thicken the torso, lengthen legs, stretch anatomy, switch left/right support feet or change the gait. Sneakers should have the original boots' sole/contact positions and comparable volume. Keep hair trailing toward image-left; every character faces right.
Return exactly the same 12-cell sheet and framing as image 1. Clean original anime linework and cel shading. Genuine transparent alpha background, no colored backdrop, no glow, no text, no labels, no scene, no cut-off heads, hair, hands, tail or feet. Change the clothing only; preserve the original body and all twelve walking poses.
items.review: Headband omitted; superseded by v2. Kept only as provenance input.
